items.title: Build OS Azure Boards Backlog Export
items.summary: Create one traceable Azure Boards import from an approved Build OS work backlog.

items.title: Backlog Selection and Mapping
items.summary: Select one authoritative backlog and map its phases and stages into an Azure hierarchy.

items.title: Select the authoritative Build OS backlog

use_case: The delivery owner needs one coherent source backlog so that the Azure tree does not mix unrelated revisions or blocked work.
outcomes: Read the selected work index and all listed phase files.
Stop when backlog authority or scope is unclear.

technical_details.text: t1: Read the work-directory routing instructions.
t2: Reconcile the index Phase Map with the phase files.
children: Record missing or extra phase files as blockers.
Preserve candidate, superseded, and approval-gate language.

acceptance_criteria: One work directory is selected as the export source.

acceptance_criteria.text: The source inventory is complete so that:
children: every Phase Map entry resolves to one phase file;
every selected stage has tasks and acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria: Candidate or superseded work is not presented as executable authority.

items.title: Azure Boards CSV Generation
items.summary: Rewrite selected stages and emit the target Azure Boards import file.

items.title: Rewrite stage content into Azure rich text

use_case: Azure Boards users need consistent rich-text fields so that each work item separates its reason, outcome, and implementation detail.
outcomes: Rewrite source acceptance bullets as observable end states.
technical_details: t1: Write USE CASE, DESCRIPTION, and TECHNICAL DETAILS once and in that order.
t2: Preserve task IDs, paths, commands, dependencies, and gates.
t3: Add the BUILD OS SOURCE trace to Design Notes.

acceptance_criteria: The Description contains all three required sections in the required order.
The Acceptance Criteria field contains an HTML unordered list of observable end states.
The Design Notes field contains the source work directory, phase file, stage, and task IDs.

items.title: Emit and validate the hierarchical import CSV

use_case: The delivery owner needs one import-ready CSV so that Azure Boards can create the full parent-child tree without manual repair.
outcomes: Emit the selected Azure Boards CSV profile.
Validate the complete file before delivery.

children: Write UTF-8 with a byte-order mark.
Write rows in Epic, Feature, and Product Backlog Item preorder.
Reject missing HTML sections or source traces.
Reject populated ID, State, or Assigned To values in a new-item profile.

acceptance_criteria: The CSV starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark.
Each row populates exactly one Title 1-4 field.
The validator exits with status 0 for the synthetic golden file.
No new-item row contains an ID, state, or assigned-user value.
